description: Na₄MoO₅ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are nine inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with five NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two MoO₅ trigonal bipyramids, edges with nine NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with two MoO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 16-28°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.50 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with five NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two MoO₅ trigonal bipyramids, edges with nine NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent MoO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-30°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.49 Å. In the third Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with five NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MoO₅ trigonal bipyramids, edges with nine NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with two MoO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-28°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.58 Å. In the fourth Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MoO₅ trigonal bipyramids, edges with ten NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent MoO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-20°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.74 Å. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-23°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.42 Å.
